description: Same-direction equivalence and a direction as a collection of rays. Retain three labelled rays, three full extended origin-joining supports, and five collection representatives; no lengths or angles are given.

authoritativeText.text: Figure-specific scope: panel a shows the three rays [A_1B_1), [A_2B_2), [A_3B_3) with the same direction, illustrating reflexivity, symmetry of that relation, and transitivity. Panel b shows representatives of the collection of all rays with the same direction as a given ray. The approved panel labels are a and b. No metric equality or later theorem is claimed by fig-216.
